newsitem.title: GERMANY: ATC named as cargo agent to start-up Spanish airli.
newsitem.headline: ATC named as cargo agent to start-up Spanish airli.

text.p: ATC Aviation Services said it has been appointed Germany cargo sales agent for start-up Spanish airline Air Truck SA.
ATC Germany manager, Ingo Zimmer, said the niche airline has launched with five ATR-72 flights a week to Munich from Pamplona, Barcelona and Madrid.
Airfreight potential on the route included the Spanish production plants of car manufacturer Volkwagen AG at Pamplona and its Seat subsidiary near Barcelona, he noted.
